# CORELINE

CORELINE is an offline-first supplement, nutrition, training, and recovery tracker.

## Product boundaries

- Local profiles and logs remain on the device unless the user explicitly enables a secure integration.
- Supplement content is educational and does not prescribe doses or replace medical advice.
- AI planning requires an independently hosted server-side integration and explicit consent.
- Nearby-store results require an independently hosted maps integration and explicit location consent.
